decision.risk_assessment: Strong macro trend intact, but short-term momentum divergence and near-zero volume near local resistance levels warrant caution.
decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH maintain strong bullish EMA alignments with high ADX readings (>50), indicating robust underlying uptrends. However, both pairs display negative MACD histograms and prices are consolidating just below 24-hour highs without sufficient volume confirmation. Entering longs at this stage offers unfavorable risk-reward, so staying flat until a clearer pullback to EMA support or a high-volume breakout occurs.
